HIFU Skin Tightening with Ultraformer III

Sagging cheeks, a blurred jawline or skin that's lost its firmness? HIFU uses focused ultrasound to lift and tighten from deep within, reaching the same layer surgeons lift in a facelift, with no cuts and no downtime. At Facelit we use the Ultraformer III, one of the most advanced HIFU machines available, for a precise, comfortable, natural-looking lift.

Treatment overview

What is HIFU?

As we age, the skin loses collagen and the deep supporting layer under it, called the SMAS, starts to loosen. Cheeks drop, jowls form, the jawline blurs and the brows feel heavy.

HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) focuses ultrasound energy at precise depths under the skin. Each pulse creates tiny points of heat that contract and tighten the tissue straight away and then trigger fresh collagen and elastin for months afterwards. The skin surface is left untouched, so there's no wound and no downtime, just a gradual, natural-looking lift.

Read more: what is the SMAS, and why does it matter?

The SMAS (superficial muscular aponeurotic system) is the layer of tissue that holds up your face. It's the layer a surgeon tightens during a facelift. Creams, peels and most lasers can't reach it.

HIFU is one of the only non-surgical treatments that can reach it. Ultraformer III's 4.5 mm cartridge targets it directly, which is why HIFU can truly lift the jowls, jawline, cheeks and brows, not just tighten the surface.

1. FocusUltrasound is focused at exact depths under the skin.
2. ContractTiny heat points tighten the tissue straight away.
3. RebuildNew collagen keeps lifting and firming for up to 6 months.
US FDA-cleared

Ultraformer III: Our HIFU Machine

Ultraformer III is a world-leading HIFU platform for multi-depth lifting and contouring of the face and body. It uses Micro and Macro Focused Ultrasound (MMFU), with dedicated cartridges that each reach a precise depth, from the upper skin to the SMAS lifting layer and deeper into the body. That precision means a lift tailored to every area of your face, in a faster and more comfortable session than older HIFU devices.

Why Ultraformer III stands out

More depths, more precision
Most basic HIFU devices offer one or two depths. Ultraformer III has dedicated cartridges for several depths, so every layer of your face can be treated exactly where it needs it.
Lifts, not just tightens
Its 4.5 mm cartridge reaches the SMAS, the facelift layer, for a real lifting effect on jowls, jawline, cheeks and brows.
Faster, more comfortable sessions
Energy is delivered quickly and precisely, so sessions are shorter and many people find them more comfortable than older HIFU.
Face and body in one machine
Body cartridges tighten the tummy, arms and thighs, and help with a double chin.
Safe for brown skin
The energy bypasses the skin surface, keeping the risk of pigmentation low for Indian skin.

The technology

One Machine, Every Layer of Your Skin

Ultraformer III treats your skin at different depths, like rebuilding a house from the foundations up. Tap a layer to see what each cartridge does.

Tap a layer to see what each cartridge does.

1.5 mm · Upper dermis

Very shallow energy that refreshes the skin surface, firming fine lines, crepey skin and texture. Ideal around the eyes and on the neck.

2.0 mm · Mid dermis

Targets the collagen-rich middle of the skin for firmness and smoother fine lines.

3.0 mm · Deep dermis

Rebuilds collagen deep in the skin for tightening and better skin quality across the face.

4.5 mm · SMAS (muscle layer)

Reaches the SMAS, the same supportive layer a surgeon lifts in a facelift. This is what gives the lifting effect on the jowls, jawline, cheeks and brows.

6–13 mm · Fat layer (body)

Longer body cartridges reach the fat layer to tighten and contour the tummy, arms and thighs, and help reduce a double chin.

Your appointment

HIFU Treatment Procedure

A proper assessment comes first.

  • Your doctor checks your skin laxity and plans the areas and depths.
  • Avoid sunburn and strong actives like retinoids for a few days before.
  • Tell us about any fillers, threads or implants in the area.
  • Come with clean skin and no makeup.
  • Take photos so you can compare at 3 months.

A session takes 30 to 90 minutes, depending on the areas.

  • Numbing cream can be applied for comfort.
  • A cool ultrasound gel is spread over the area.
  • The doctor maps the face and moves the handpiece line by line.
  • Each cartridge treats a different depth, from the surface to the SMAS.
  • You'll feel warm, prickling or tapping sensations, mostly over bone.

Go straight back to your day.

  • Mild redness or swelling for a few hours.
  • The jawline may feel tender for a few days.
  • Use gentle skincare and sunscreen.
  • Results build over 2 to 3 months as collagen forms.
  • We review your results at 3 months.

Results

HIFU Results Timeline

HIFU works with your body's own collagen, so results build naturally over months.

  1. Day 1

    Instant firmness

    A slight lift and tighter feel from the immediate tissue contraction.

  2. Weeks 4–8

    Collagen kicks in

    Skin starts to look firmer and smoother.

  3. Months 2–3

    Visible lift

    Jawline, cheeks and brows look lifted. We review you at 3 months.

  4. Up to 6 months

    Keeps improving

    Collagen keeps building. Results usually last 12 to 18 months.

Illustrative model images. Results vary from person to person.

A good fit if you

  • Have mild to moderate sagging
  • Have a blurred jawline, jowls or heavy brows
  • Want a lift without surgery or downtime
  • Want to prevent sagging in your 30s

Not ideal if you

  • Have very loose, heavy skin (surgery may help more)
  • Are pregnant
  • Have open wounds, active acne or infection in the area
  • Have metal implants in the treatment area

Aftercare

HIFU Aftercare

There's no real downtime, but a few simple steps help your results.

Do

  • Use a gentle cleanser and moisturiser
  • Apply sunscreen
  • Drink plenty of water
  • Use a cold pack if you feel tender

Avoid

  • Very hot showers, saunas and steam
  • Heavy exercise on the day
  • Retinoids and acids for 3 days
  • Pressing hard on tender spots

Do

  • Wear SPF 30 or higher every day
  • Keep up good skincare
  • Eat protein and stay hydrated to support collagen
  • Come for your 3-month review

Remember

  • Results build gradually
  • Compare photos at 3 months
  • A yearly top-up keeps results

Myths vs facts

HIFU Myths, Busted

"All HIFU machines are the same."
Machines differ in depths, precision and comfort. Ultraformer III's multi-depth cartridges allow a far more tailored lift.
"HIFU results show immediately."
There's a slight instant lift, but the real results come from new collagen over 2 to 3 months.
"HIFU melts your face fat."
On the face, HIFU targets the skin and SMAS to lift and tighten. Body cartridges are used where fat reduction is wanted.
"It's only for older people."
Many people start in their 30s to keep collagen strong and delay sagging.
"HIFU is the same as a facelift."
HIFU gives a natural, moderate lift without surgery. Very loose skin may still need a surgical facelift.

Safety first

Side Effects and Who Should Wait

HIFU is non-invasive and very well tolerated. Here's what's normal and when to check with your doctor first.

Common and temporary

  • Mild redness or swelling for a few hours
  • Tenderness along the jawline for a few days
  • Tingling or slight numbness that settles
  • Rarely, small bruises or welts that fade

Talk to your doctor first if you

  • Are pregnant
  • Have open wounds, active acne or infection in the area
  • Have metal implants, a pacemaker or recent fillers or threads in the area
  • Have a bleeding disorder or take blood thinners
  • Have had recent facial surgery

Questions

HIFU & Ultraformer III FAQs

What is HIFU?
HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound) is a non-surgical skin lifting and tightening treatment. It focuses ultrasound energy at precise depths under the skin, creating tiny heat points that trigger new collagen and tighten the deep supporting layer, without harming the skin surface.
What is Ultraformer III?
Ultraformer III is an advanced HIFU machine that uses Micro and Macro Focused Ultrasound (MMFU). It has multiple cartridges that treat the skin at different depths, from 1.5 mm up to the SMAS layer at 4.5 mm and deeper body layers, so treatment can be precisely tailored to each area.
Why is Ultraformer III better than regular HIFU?
It treats more depths with dedicated cartridges, delivers energy quickly and precisely, and is designed for a more comfortable session than older HIFU devices. That means a more tailored lift with less discomfort.
Is HIFU painful?
You'll feel warm, prickling or deep tapping sensations, especially over bony areas like the jawline. Most people find Ultraformer III very manageable. We can apply numbing cream and adjust the settings for comfort.
How many HIFU sessions do I need?
Most people need just one session. Mature or very loose skin may benefit from a second session after about 3 months. A yearly top-up keeps results going.
When will I see HIFU results?
Some people notice a slight lift straight away. The main results build over 2 to 3 months as new collagen forms, and keep improving for up to 6 months.
How long do HIFU results last?
Usually 12 to 18 months, depending on your age, skin and lifestyle. A yearly session helps maintain them.
Is HIFU safe for Indian skin?
Yes. HIFU energy passes under the skin surface without heating the top layer, so the risk of pigmentation is low, which suits brown skin well.
What is the downtime?
There's no real downtime. Mild redness or swelling can last a few hours, and some people feel tender along the jaw for a few days.
Can HIFU replace a facelift?
HIFU gives a natural, moderate lift for mild to moderate sagging. It isn't a replacement for surgery when skin is very loose, but it's a great option for people who want to avoid surgery or delay it.
What age is best for HIFU?
HIFU works best from the 30s to early 60s, when skin has started to loosen but still has good quality. Starting earlier helps prevent sagging.
Can HIFU reduce a double chin?
Yes. Deeper cartridges firm the skin and help reduce small fat under the chin for a cleaner profile.
Can HIFU be used on the body?
Yes. Body cartridges tighten loose skin on the tummy, arms and thighs.
Who should not have HIFU?
HIFU isn't suitable during pregnancy, with open wounds, active acne or infection in the area, or with metal implants or fillers in the treatment area that your doctor advises against. Tell your doctor about any health conditions.
Where can I get HIFU in Kerala?
Facelit offers HIFU with Ultraformer III at our clinic in Trivandrum. Contact us to check availability at our other branches.
How much does HIFU cost?
It depends on the area and number of sessions. Face & Neck together offers better value. Book a consultation for a personalised quote.
